game_concept: A action puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes, dunes at sunset: the desert nomad must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes: dunes at sunset
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunset Dunes, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round, a new dates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 210 points of dates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 210, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sunset Dunes'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Sunset Dunes.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 210 within 63 seconds.
